newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian president not injured in bomb attempt-TV.
newsitem.headline: Albanian president not injured in bomb attempt-TV.

text.p: A bomb was thrown at Albanian President Sali Berisha during a campaign rally outside Tirana but was caught by his bodyguards and did not explode, state television said on Wednesday.
The bomb was thrown while the president was making an appearance in the village of Shkallnuer, about 40 km (25 miles) west of Tirana near the port of Durres, the television said.

"There was an attack from terrorists against the President of the Republic Sali Berisha which failed because of the courage, bravery and readiness of the group of his bodyguards and the people who were present," the television said.
One of the bodyguards lunged to catch the bomb and the citizens surrounded the president like a defensive wall to protect his life, the television said.
The television said one suspect was caught. He was being treated in hospital but the television gave no information about how he was injured.
